provenance.statement: The final per-pixel RLE in `rows` is the sole authoritative source of the a16 occlusion semantics (R1A-R7 hand/cuff connectivity re-adjudication). Rows are consumed read-only; changed pixels are documented in hand_ledger.json [y, x_start, x_end, old_class, new_class, reason] with reasons from the closed vocabulary (HAND_CONNECTIVITY, CUFF_BOUNDARY).
